body.title: Post-apply sweep and the marker
body.summary: Add src/workflow/convert/sweep.ts and src/workflow/convert/marker.ts and a writeRepoSchema in src/workflow/artifact-core/repo-schema.ts: sweep every head (decodes, no legacy field other than meta.rangeBase, checkHeadIntegrity and checkIntegrity, stored revision, status and approval kept) and write .insrc/schema.json by temporary file and rename only if the sweep is clean. Tests src/workflow/convert/__tests__/convert-marker.test.ts and the existing src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/repo-schema.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: The marker is written last and only when every head is clean
A head that still carries a legacy field is listed and blocks the marker

tests.name: convert-marker.test.ts: the marker is written last and only when every head is clean
